messages.displayText: We hope you’ll visit us again.
Sorry, but it doesn’t seem you can afford that.
What will you be having today?
Understood! We hope you’ll come again.
That’ll be <U+E300><U+0010><U+0003>Ȇ<U+0000>,. Does that sound all right?
What will you be having today?

I’m sorry, but you don’t have enough to pay for
the drink you chose.
Ugh. Then why are you even here?

Look at you—can’t afford one measly drink, can
you? What’re you wasting my time for, then?

Here you are: one Ember Roast! Enjoy the flavor—
that bite comes from a hint of char on the beans.

Here you are: one Flamethrower Roast! Savor the
blend of sour, bitter, and sweet notes.

Here you are: one Fire Blast Roast! This one’s less
acidic—a nice, bitter, fragrant roast.

Here you are: one Burn Up Roast! This is the
darkest roast we’ve got—really rich and bitter.

All right, one Panchamomile Tea! Rich flavor and a
nice, sweet aroma—plus it packs a real punch!

All right, one Wooloolong Tea! It’s refreshing,
even if it does smell a bit like wet wool.

All right, one Roserade Tea! This one’s nice and
gentle, with a great aroma. Popular in Alola, too.

All right, one Moomoo Milk! It’s bursting with
nutritional value.

All right, one Fresh Water! Apparently ours has
more magnesium than in some other regions.

All right, one Sparkling Water! Enjoy a different
experience than you get with flat mineral water.

Welcome to Café Introversion, home to those who
like communicating—just maybe not face-to-face.

Welcome to Café Cyclone, where all the most
interesting people gather!

Welcome to Café Classe, the café for fashionistas
and those who live in style.

Welcome to Café Woof, the place for those who
simply adore Furfrou.
Welcome to Café Soleil, the hottest spot around!

Welcome to Shutterbug Café, the place for all us
camera nuts who love taking photos!

Welcome to Café Rouleau, home of the city’s
most beloved chocolate tarte!

Welcome to Café Gallant, the café with a dark,
rich appeal for those who can appreciate it.

Welcome to Café Pokémon-Amie, where we all
just love playing with our Pokémon!

Welcome to Café Triste...where we like to keep
quiet.

Welcome to Café Kizuna, where patrons love
talking about their bonds with their Pokémon.

Welcome to Café Ultimo, a watering hole for
those who seek the ultimate coffee experience.

Welcome to Café Action! This is the place for folks
trying to take photos that’ll do big numbers!

Welcome to Café Bataille, the place for those who
love Pokémon battling!

Thanks for stopping by! This is Nouveau Café’s
Truck No. 2, where we serve up loving comfort!

Thanks for stopping by! This is Nouveau Café’s
Truck No. 3, where we serve up loving comfort!
Are you all done with your camera?

Welcome to Café Triste. Please, please do not
order the sushi-coffee combo.
